hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.name: Roadmap
hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.doc: `<Roadmap items={[{ time: "2025 Q1", title: "Launch", status: "done" }, { time: "Q3", title: "Teams", status: "now" }]} />`

props.name: badges
props.type: boolean | ((status: RoadmapStatus, text: unknown) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The status badge next to each title: true (default), false, or `(status, text) => node`.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: Fill the line with the scroll (default true).

props.name: rail
props.doc: The line with its fill (default true); false leaves the dots only.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the fill and of the dots it has passed (default: the brand gradient and the accent).

props.name: labels
props.doc: Texts of the statuses (defaults: "Done", "In progress", "Planned").

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the entries: Reveal options, or false for none (default: from the start, one after another).

hadi-march/landing#Roadmap.tr: Yol haritası zaman çizelgesi: `<Roadmap items={[{ time: "2025 Ç1", title: "Çıkış", status: "done" }]} />`.

props.name: target
props.doc: Measure this element (an article) instead of the whole page.

props.name: position
props.doc: fixed (top of the viewport, default) or inline.

props.name: paint
props.doc: gradient (brand colours, default) or accent.

props.name: size
props.doc: Bar height in px (default 3).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the fill (a theme token); wins over `paint`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Reading progress").

hadi-march/landing#ScrollStory.name: ScrollStory

props.name: side
props.doc: Media column side (default end).

props.name: theme
props.doc: Tint the section with the active step's colour (default true).

props.name: onStep
props.doc: Called when the active step changes.

props.name: dots
props.doc: The dots under the pinned picture (default true).

props.name: numbers
props.doc: The step number above each title: true (default: "01"), false, or `(index) => node`.

props.name: transition
props.type: "rise" | "fade" | "none" | ((incoming: HTMLElement, outgoing: HTMLElement | undefined, direction: 1 | -1) => void) | undefined
props.doc: How the pinned picture changes: "rise" (default), "fade", "none", or your own `(incoming, outgoing, direction) => void` (direction 1 = scrolling down).

hadi-march/landing#ScrollStory.tr: Kaydırmalı anlatı: `<ScrollStory steps={[{ title: "Planla", body: "…", media: <Chart/>, color: "brand-blue" }]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.name: SiteFooter
hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.doc: `<SiteFooter brand={{ name: "HADİ" }} columns={[{ title: "Product", links: [{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing" }] }]} />`

props.name: copyright
props.doc: Bottom start (default "© <year> <brand name>"); false for none.

props.name: wordmark
props.doc: A large wordmark across the bottom (text or your own node).

props.name: toTop
props.doc: "Back to top" button (default true).

props.name: toTopIcon
props.doc: Icon of the "back to top" button (default: an arrow up).

props.name: toTopLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "back to top" button (default "Back to top").

hadi-march/landing#SiteFooter.tr: Site altbilgisi: `<SiteFooter brand={{ name: "HADİ" }} columns={[{ title: "Ürün", links: [{ label: "Fiyatlar", href: "/pricing" }] }]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#SiteNav.name: SiteNav
hadi-march/landing#SiteNav.doc: `<SiteNav brand={{ name: "HADİ", mark: logo, href: "/" }} links={[{ label: "Pricing", href: "#pricing" }]} actions={<Button>Start</Button>} mode="transparent" />`

props.name: brand
props.doc: A Brand (props) or any node.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons at the end (sign in, primary call to action). Also shown in the mobile drawer.

props.name: mode
props.doc: solid (default) · transparent until scrolled · floating glass pill.

props.name: shrink
props.doc: Lower bar once scrolled (default true).

props.name: hide
props.doc: Slide away while scrolling down (default false).

props.name: threshold
props.doc: Pixels of scroll before it counts as scrolled (default 12).

props.name: sticky
props.doc: Sticky (default) or static.

props.name: onNavigate
props.doc: Called when a link is chosen (desktop or drawer).

props.name: pill
props.doc: The pill that slides under the hovered link and rests on the current one (default true).

props.name: pillColor
props.doc: Colour of the pill (default: a soft neutral).

props.name: menu
props.doc: The menu button of narrow screens (default true); false when you open your own menu.

props.name: menuIcon
props.doc: Icon of the menu button (default: three lines).

props.name: drawerSide
props.doc: Side the drawer opens from (default "right").

props.name: labels
props.type: { main?: string | undefined; openMenu?: string | undefined; menu?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: accessible name of the navigation ("Main"), name of the menu button ("Open menu"), title of the drawer ("Menu").

hadi-march/landing#SiteNav.tr: Site üst menüsü: `<SiteNav brand={{ name: "HADİ", mark: logo, href: "/" }} links={[…]} actions={<Button>Başla</Button>} mode="transparent" />`.

hadi-march/landing#SiteSection.name: SiteSection

props.name: align
props.doc: Heading alignment (default center).

props.name: width
props.doc: Content width: narrow 46rem · default 72rem · wide 84rem · full (edge to edge).

props.name: space
props.doc: Vertical padding (default md).

props.name: level
props.doc: Heading level for the title (default 2).

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the section: the eyebrow, the `brand` tone and every accent inside follow it (default: the accent).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the heading group: Reveal options, or false for none (default: up, one after another).

hadi-march/landing#SiteSection.tr: Site bölümü: `<SiteSection eyebrow="Özellikler" title="Gereken her şey" lead="…">…</SiteSection>`.

props.name: notes
props.doc: Speaker notes (shown in the speaker view).

props.name: layout
props.doc: title (centred, large) · content (heading + body, default) · split (two columns) · center · image (full-bleed media).

props.name: tone
props.doc: plain · inverse · brand (gradient)

props.name: background
props.doc: A decorative layer behind the slide (an Overlay, a VideoBackground…).

hadi-march/landing#StatsBand.name: StatsBand
hadi-march/landing#StatsBand.doc: `<StatsBand items={[{ value: 12000, label: "teams", format: { notation: "compact" } }, { value: 99.9, decimals: 1, suffix: "%", label: "uptime" }]} />`

props.name: mode
props.doc: Counter style (default count); "none" writes the number without counting.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the numbers (default: the text colour).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the items: Reveal options, or false for none (default: up, one after another).

hadi-march/landing#StatsBand.tr: Rakam bandı: `<StatsBand items={[{ value: 12000, label: "ekip", format: { notation: "compact" } }, { value: 99.9, decimals: 1, suffix: "%", label: "çalışma süresi" }]} />`.

hadi-march/landing#storyEndings.name: storyEndings
hadi-march/landing#storyEndings.doc: Every ending reachable from `start` (passages without choices), in reading order.
hadi-march/landing#storyEndings.signature: function storyEndings(passages: Record<string, StoryPassage>, start: string): string[]
hadi-march/landing#storyEndings.tr: Bir hikâyede başlangıçtan ulaşılabilen bütün sonlar (seçimi olmayan bölümler).

hadi-march/landing#Testimonials.name: Testimonials
hadi-march/landing#Testimonials.doc: `<Testimonials variant="wall" items={[{ quote: "…", name: "Ada", role: "CTO, HADİ", rating: 5 }]} />`

props.name: cols
props.doc: Grid / slider columns (default 3).

props.name: rating
props.doc: The star rating of a card (default true).

props.name: ratingColor
props.doc: Colour of the stars (default: the accent).

props.name: avatar
props.doc: The avatar next to the name (default true).

props.name: quotes
props.doc: The quotation marks around the quote (default true).

props.name: more
props.doc: wall: the "Show more" button (default true); false shows the whole wall.

props.name: speed
props.doc: marquee: speed of the two rows, px per second (default [28, 20]).

props.name: reveal
props.doc: Entrance of the cards (grid, wall): Reveal options, or false for none.

props.name: labels
props.type: { more?: unknown; less?: unknown; /** Accessible name of the slider. */ slider?: string | undefined; /** Accessible name of a rating. */ rating?: ((value: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; every one defaults to the built-in translated text.

hadi-march/landing#Testimonials.tr: Kullanıcı yorumları: `<Testimonials variant="wall" items={[{ quote: "…", name: "Ada", role: "CTO, HADİ", rating: 5 }]} />`.

props.name: src
props.doc: Video URL (mp4 / webm).

props.name: poster
props.doc: Poster image: shown first, and instead of the video on save-data / reduced motion.

props.name: tint
props.doc: Text readability layer: dark (default), light, brand, none.

props.name: tintOpacity
props.doc: Tint strength 0–1 (default .45).

props.name: position
props.doc: object-position of the video ("center", "50% 30%").

props.name: controls
props.doc: Show the pause button (default true).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own icons of the pause button (an icon or a node each).

props.name: labels
props.type: { play?: string | undefined; pause?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names of the pause button (defaults: "Play background video", "Pause background video").

hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.name: undoHistory
hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.doc: A separate history with the same engine (merge window, transactions, saved point); events go nowhere.
hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.tr: Aynı motorla ayrı bir geçmiş (birleştirme penceresi, işlemler, kaydedilmiş nokta); olaylar hiçbir yere gitmez.

hadi-march/flow#createFlow.tr: Akış deposu: `const flow = createFlow({ types, doc })`, ardından `<FlowCanvas flow={flow} />`.

hadi-march/flow#emit.tr: run() içinden: değerleri yalnız seçilen çıkış bağlantı noktalarına gönderir (`emit({ yes: order })`); diğerleri atlanır.

hadi-march/flow#emitted.name: emitted
hadi-march/flow#emitted.doc: The ports a node run chose with emit(), or null when it returned a plain value.
hadi-march/flow#emitted.signature: function emitted(v: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null
hadi-march/flow#emitted.tr: Bir düğüm çalıştırmasının emit() ile seçtiği bağlantı noktaları; düz değer döndürdüyse null.

hadi-march/flow#endOf.name: endOf
hadi-march/flow#endOf.doc: "node.port" → [node, port] (the port is after the last dot).

hadi-march/flow#FLOW_NODE.name: FLOW_NODE
hadi-march/flow#FLOW_NODE.doc: Node geometry in px (width, header height, port row height) for custom layouts.

hadi-march/flow#FLOW_NODE.valueType: { width: number; head: number; row: number; }

hadi-march/flow#FLOW_NODE.tr: Özel yerleşimler için düğüm geometrisi, px cinsinden (genişlik, başlık yüksekliği, bağlantı noktası satır yüksekliği).

hadi-march/flow#FLOW_SCHEMA.name: FLOW_SCHEMA
hadi-march/flow#FLOW_SCHEMA.doc: Schema id written into saved flows (march.flow/v1); validateFlow checks it.
hadi-march/flow#FLOW_SCHEMA.tr: Kaydedilen akışlara yazılan şema kimliği (march.flow/v1); validateFlow bunu denetler.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Grid step in world units for snapping and the dotted background; 0 turns snapping off. Default 16.

props.name: minimap
props.doc: Show the minimap. Default true.

props.name: tool
props.doc: Drag on the empty canvas: "select" draws a selection box (pan with Space / middle button), "pan" moves the view. Default "select".

props.name: fields
props.doc: Show the field controls inside nodes. Default true.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name.

props.name: controls
props.doc: The zoom bar: true (default), false, or the parts to keep: "zoom" (− % +), "fit", "layout".

props.name: menu
props.type: boolean | ((items: MenuItem[], target: Element) => readonly MenuItem[]) | undefined
props.doc: The context menu: true (default), false, or a function that gets the built-in items and returns the ones to show.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Draw-in of edges, moving dots, glow / shake / pop of nodes, the view and layout tweens (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; node?: string; menu?: string; minimap?: string; zoomIn?: string; zoomOut?: string; fit?: string; layout?: string; copy?: string; cut?: string; duplicate?: string; group?: string; ungroup?: string; delete?: string; paste?: string; selectAll?: string; add?: ((type: string) => string) | undefined; input?: ((port: string) => string) | undefined; output?: ((port: string) => string) | undefined; connection?: ((from: string, to: string) => string) | undefined; values?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; connected?: string; cannotConnect?: string; choosePort?: string; arranged?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; copied?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; pasted?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; deleted?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; selected?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one. Names: `editor` and `node` (role descriptions), `menu`, `minimap`, the zoom bar (`zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `fit`, `layout`), the menu items (`copy`, `cut`, `duplicate`, `group`, `ungroup`, `delete`, `paste`, `selectAll`, `add(type)`), ports and edges (`input(port)`, `output(port)`, `connection(from, to)`, `values(count)`) and what is announced (`connected`, `cannotConnect`, `choosePort`, `arranged(n)`, `copied(n)`, `pasted(n)`, `deleted(n)`, `selected(n)`).

hadi-march/flow#FlowControls.name: FlowControls
hadi-march/flow#FlowControls.doc: `<FlowControls runner={runner} flow={flow} timeline />` — Space runs / pauses while the toolbar has focus.

props.name: flow
props.doc: The flow (for the node counter).

props.name: speeds
props.doc: Speed choices. Default [0.5, 1, 2, 4]; false hides the speed switch.

props.name: timeline
props.doc: Show FlowTimeline under the buttons. Default false.

props.name: step
props.doc: The Step button (default true).

props.name: reset
props.doc: The Reset button (default true).

props.name: status
props.doc: The state chip: "Ready", "Running" … (default true).

props.name: clock
props.doc: The clock (default true).

props.name: count
props.doc: The "n / m nodes" counter (default true; needs `flow`).

props.name: icons
props.type: { run?: unknown; pause?: unknown; step?: unknown; reset?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Own icons for the buttons: an icon, a string or a node each.

props.name: labels
props.type: { toolbar?: string; run?: string; pause?: string; resume?: string; step?: string; reset?: string; speed?: string; ready?: string; running?: string; paused?: string; finished?: string; failed?: string; count?: ((done: number, total: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the toolbar name, the buttons, the speed switch, the five states and the counter.

hadi-march/flow#FlowControls.tr: `<FlowControls runner={runner} flow={flow} timeline />` — araç çubuğu odaktayken Space çalıştırır / duraklatır.

props.name: types
props.doc: Types to offer. Default: every type of the flow.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Grid step used when dropping (match the canvas `snap`). Default 16.

props.name: search
props.doc: Show the search box. Default true.

props.name: categories
props.doc: The category titles (default true).

props.name: descriptions
props.doc: The description line of a card (default true).

props.name: grip
props.doc: The grip dots at the end of a card (default true).

props.name: renderCard
props.doc: Own card content: `(type) => node`. The card stays a button: drag, click and Enter work as before.

props.name: empty
props.doc: What a search without a match shows: true (default text), false (nothing) or your own node.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The tilt of a dragged card, its melt into the canvas and its fly-back (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { region?: string; search?: string; hint?: string; empty?: string } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the region name, the search box, the screen reader hint of a card, the "no match" text.

props.name: onAdd
props.doc: Called after a node is added.

hadi-march/flow#flowStatusText.name: flowStatusText
hadi-march/flow#flowStatusText.doc: Localised label of a node run state ("running", "failed" …), as the canvas and FlowControls show it.
hadi-march/flow#flowStatusText.tr: Bir düğüm çalışma durumunun yerelleştirilmiş etiketi ("running", "failed" gibi); tuval ve FlowControls'ta görüldüğü gibi.

hadi-march/flow#FlowTimeline.name: FlowTimeline
hadi-march/flow#FlowTimeline.doc: `<FlowTimeline runner={runner} flow={flow} />` — the run record: when each node started and how long it took.

props.name: axis
props.doc: The time axis with its ticks and playhead (default true).

props.name: empty
props.doc: What is shown before the first run: true (default text), false (nothing) or your own node.

props.name: labels
props.type: { region?: string; empty?: string; row?: ((start: string, duration: string) => string) | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the region name, the text before the first run, and what a row says after its node's name.

hadi-march/flow#FlowTimeline.tr: `<FlowTimeline runner={runner} flow={flow} />` — çalıştırma kaydı: her düğümün ne zaman başladığı ve ne kadar sürdüğü.

hadi-march/flow#Minimap.name: Minimap

hadi-march/flow#NODE_W.tr: Dünya birimlerinde düğüm genişliği (bağlantı noktaları satır içi kenarlarında durur).

hadi-march/seo#applyHead.doc: Write tags to document.head: update in place, restore or remove what is no longer wanted. `scripts: false` leaves JSON-LD alone (neither written nor removed: blocks from the build stay).
hadi-march/seo#applyHead.signature: function applyHead(tags: readonly Tag[], __1: { lang?: string | undefined; scripts?: boolean } = {}, doc: Document | undefined = globalThis.document): void
hadi-march/seo#applyHead.tr: Etiketleri document.head'e yazar: yerinde günceller, artık istenmeyenleri geri yükler veya kaldırır. `scripts: false` JSON-LD'ye dokunmaz (ne yazılır ne kaldırılır: derlemeden gelen bloklar kalır).

hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.name: checkHtml
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.doc: Check one page. Errors: what search engines need; warnings: what most pages should have.
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.signature: function checkHtml(html: string, opts: SeoCheckOptions = {}): SeoIssue[]
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.tr: Tek bir sayfayı denetler. Hatalar: arama motorlarının gereksindiği; uyarılar: çoğu sayfada olması gereken.

hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.name: formatIssues
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.doc: One line per issue, for terminals and previews.
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.signature: function formatIssues(file: string, issues: readonly SeoIssue[]): string
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.tr: Sorun başına bir satır; uçbirimler ve önizlemeler için.

hadi-march/seo#headTags.name: headTags
hadi-march/seo#headTags.doc: The tags written to <head> now (reactive): previews, tests.
hadi-march/seo#headTags.tr: Şu an <head> içine yazılan etiketler (tepkisel): önizlemeler, testler.

hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.name: headToHtml
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.doc: Tags as HTML text (build time, previews). `mark` adds data-hm-head so the client adopts them.
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.signature: function headToHtml(tags: readonly Tag[], __1: { mark?: boolean } = {}): string
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.tr: Etiketleri HTML metni olarak verir (derleme zamanı, önizlemeler). `mark` istemcinin sahiplenmesi için data-hm-head ekler.

hadi-march/seo#installSeo.name: installSeo
hadi-march/seo#installSeo.doc: Turn on route heads: the router hands each route's `head` (and title) here on every navigation.
hadi-march/seo#installSeo.tr: Rota başlıklarını açar: yönlendirici her gezinmede her rotanın `head` (ve title) değerini buraya verir.

hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.name: jsonLdText
hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.doc: JSON for a <script type="application/ld+json"> body: "</script" and "<!--" can never close or confuse the element.
hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.tr: Bir <script type="application/ld+json"> gövdesi için JSON: "</script" ve "<!--" öğeyi asla kapatamaz veya şaşırtamaz.

hadi-march/seo#ld.name: ld
hadi-march/seo#ld.doc: JSON-LD builders: WebSite, Organization, Article, Product, Breadcrumb, FAQ.
hadi-march/seo#ld.signature: const ld: { website: (o: { name: string; url: string; search?: string; }) => JsonLd; organization: (o: OrgInput) => JsonLd; breadcrumbs: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[], site?: string) => JsonLd; article: (o: ArticleInput) => JsonLd; product: (o: ProductInput) => JsonLd; faq: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => JsonLd; }
hadi-march/seo#ld.valueType: { website: (o: { name: string; url: string; search?: string; }) => JsonLd; organization: (o: OrgInput) => JsonLd; breadcrumbs: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[], site?: string) => JsonLd; article: (o: ArticleInput) => JsonLd; product: (o: ProductInput) => JsonLd; faq: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => JsonLd; }
hadi-march/seo#ld.tr: JSON-LD oluşturucuları: WebSite, Organization, Article, Product, Breadcrumb, FAQ.

hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.name: resolveHead
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.doc: Merge head inputs (later ones win) into the list of tags to write.
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.signature: function resolveHead(inputs: readonly (HeadInput | null | undefined | false)[], opts: ResolveOptions = {}): Tag[]
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.tr: Başlık girdilerini birleştirir (sonrakiler kazanır) ve yazılacak etiket listesini üretir.

hadi-march/seo#scanTags.name: scanTags
hadi-march/seo#scanTags.doc: Start tags (with attributes) and the text of raw-text elements, in document order.
hadi-march/seo#scanTags.tr: Başlangıç etiketleri (öznitelikleriyle) ve ham metin öğelerinin metni, belge sırasıyla.

hadi-march/seo#tagKey.name: tagKey
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.doc: The key a tag (as attributes) is matched by: the same rules for tags written here and tags found in the HTML.
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.signature: function tagKey(tag: string, a: Record<string, string | null | undefined>): string | null
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.tr: Bir etiketin (öznitelikleri olarak) eşleştirildiği anahtar: burada yazılan etiketler ve HTML'de bulunanlar için aynı kurallar.

hadi-march/seo#useHead.name: useHead
hadi-march/seo#useHead.doc: Add head tags while the calling component lives (removed with it). `input` may be a function: it is tracked, so signals read inside update the head.
hadi-march/seo#useHead.signature: function useHead(input: HeadInput | (() => HeadInput | null | undefined)): () => void
hadi-march/seo#useHead.tr: Çağıran bileşen yaşadığı sürece başlık etiketleri ekler (onunla birlikte kaldırılır). `input` bir işlev olabilir: izlenir, içinde okunan sinyaller başlığı günceller.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.name: hydrate
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.doc: Take over prerendered HTML (data-hm-prerender) without a flash, or render normally when there is none.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.signature: function hydrate(fn: () => unknown, el: Element, opts: HydrateOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.tr: Önceden oluşturulmuş HTML'i (data-hm-prerender) titremeden devralır; yoksa normal çizer.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.name: HYDRATING_ATTR
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.doc: Set on <html> while hydrate() builds the app off-screen: what renders then is already on screen as prerendered HTML, so entrance animations (motion reveal) skip it and the swap shows no change. A DOM attribute, not an import: the motion code needs no dependency on this chunk.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#HYDRATING_ATTR.tr: hydrate() uygulamayı ekran dışında kurarken <html> üzerinde duran öznitelik: giriş animasyonları ön işlenmiş içeriği yeniden oynatmaz.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.name: prerenderedFor
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.doc: True when the URL shows the route prerendered into `el` (data-hm-prerender: "#/x" for hash routing, else "/x"). History routing compares the path under the app's base (appBase()), so it works in any sub-folder. An address that names another route — an old hash link (#/x), the hash fallback, or the ?hm-path= of a 404 fallback — never matches a path-prerendered page.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.tr: URL, `el` içine önceden oluşturulmuş rotayı gösteriyorsa true (data-hm-prerender: karma yönlendirmede "#/x", aksi halde "/x"). Geçmiş yönlendirmesi yolun sonunu karşılaştırır, böylece her tabanda çalışır; "/" yalnız klasör URL'sine uyar.

hadi-march/managers/accessibility/ui#Acc.name: AccessibilitySettings
hadi-march/managers/accessibility/ui#Acc.doc: Every preference, applied as it changes.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.name: comboOf
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.doc: aria-keyshortcuts ("Control+Shift+S", first of several) or data-hotkey ("mod+shift+s") → a combo for formatKey.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.tr: aria-keyshortcuts ("Control+Shift+S", birden çoksa ilki) veya data-hotkey ("mod+shift+s") → formatKey için bir birleşim.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.name: holdHint
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.doc: "Hold Alt to see shortcuts" line for a footer or a help page.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.tr: Alt bilgi veya yardım sayfası için "Kısayolları görmek için Alt'a basılı tutun" satırı.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.name: ShortcutHelp
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.doc: The help list, grouped; inactive ones (another scope, under a modal) are dimmed.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.tr: Gruplanmış yardım listesi; etkin olmayanlar (başka kapsam, kipli pencere altında) soluk gösterilir.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.name: ShortcutHints
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.doc: Mount once (e.g. in the app shell).

hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.name: RICH_SCHEMA
hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.doc: Rich text: paragraphs, headings, quotes, lists, code, links, emphasis.
hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.tr: Zengin metin: paragraflar, başlıklar, alıntılar, listeler, kod, bağlantılar, vurgu.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.name: BLOCKS
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.doc: Block-level elements (normalizeBlocks keeps them at the top level).
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.tr: Blok düzeyi öğeler (normalizeBlocks bunları en üst düzeyde tutar).

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.name: decodeEntities
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.doc: Decode character references (& ' 😀 and common named ones).
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.tr: Karakter başvurularını çözer (& ' 😀 ve yaygın adlandırılmış olanlar).

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.name: normalizeBlocks
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.doc:
Make `root`'s children a clean list of blocks: runs of inline nodes are wrapped in

,

and other containers are flattened, whitespace between blocks is removed, a

inside

  • /
    is unwrapped (
    between), and h1 becomes h2 when `topHeading` is 2. Returns root.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.signature: function normalizeBlocks<T extends Node>(root: T, opts: { topHeading?: number } = {}): T
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.tr:
`root`'un alt öğelerini temiz bir blok listesi yapar: satır içi düğüm dizileri

içine sarılır,

ve diğer kapsayıcılar düzleştirilir, bloklar arası boşluk kaldırılır,
  • /
    içindeki

    açılır.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.name: parseHtml
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.doc: Parse an HTML string into a fragment of allowlisted nodes. Inline styles are read only to keep emphasis that office suites encode as styles (font-weight, font-style, text-decoration); they are never copied.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.signature: function parseHtml(html: string, schema: SafeSchema = RICH_SCHEMA, d: Document = globalThis.document): DocumentFragment
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.tr: Bir HTML dizesini izin verilen düğümlerden oluşan bir parçaya ayrıştırır. Satır içi stiller yalnızca ofis uygulamalarının stil olarak kodladığı vurguyu (font-weight, font-style, text-decoration) korumak için okunur; asla kopyalanmaz.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.name: sanitizeNode
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.doc: Copy `node`'s children through the schema (the same rules as parseHtml) into a new fragment.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.signature: function sanitizeNode(node: Node, schema: SafeSchema = RICH_SCHEMA): DocumentFragment
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.tr: `node`'un alt öğelerini şemadan geçirerek (parseHtml ile aynı kurallar) yeni bir parçaya kopyalar.

hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.name: toMarkdown
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.doc: Write a DOM tree (a root whose children are blocks: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) as Markdown.
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.tr: Bir DOM ağacını (alt öğeleri blok olan bir kök: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) Markdown olarak yazar.
